entries.what: Brakes lab 8-11 at Tamsen Valley College, then lunch at home off Pell Road. He decides on a dinner and a gel-manicure gift card for Ximena's Nov 15 birthday and asks the assistant to word the card.
entries.outcome: Birthday plan set; card wording drafted to sound practical and sincere.

entries.what: Monday evening pickup soccer at Delgado Park, then home to watch engine teardown videos before bed around midnight.

Engine performance with Salas 1-4 at Tamsen Valley; a G1 practice quiz is scheduled for tomorrow. That night he plays his voice-memo flashcards while doing dishes and asks for tricks to stop second-guessing on timed quizzes.
entries.outcome: Gets a few simple rules, like trusting the first answer unless he can name why it's wrong.

entries.what: Mid-morning he rereads his flashcard list and recites it on the drive in the Taco, with cumbia on low.
entries.outcome: Knows about two-thirds of the cards cold.

entries.what: Brakes lab in the morning, then takes the G1 practice quiz and scores 71%, just over the 70% needed. He texts the assistant asking whether it was probably luck.
entries.outcome: Passes the bar; the assistant points to the flashcards as the reason.

entries.what: He tells Gladys and Oscar the score at dinner and gets a big hug from his mom. Afterward he checks scan tool listings online again.
entries.outcome: Family proud; he keeps his purchase plans quiet for now.

entries.what: Engine performance 1-4 with Salas at Tamsen Valley. The day passes without much trouble.
Works the stand at the Ruel Road gas station lot 5-10 p.m. He runs the griddle while listening to flashcard memos and checks the generator.
entries.outcome: Good night of sales; home near 10:30.

entries.what: Brakes lab skipped no days; lunch with Dante, who pitches another auction Civic that Rafael says he'll think about.
Stand shift on the new lot from 5. At 8:50 he leaves to pick up Dulce at Taquería Colima, since homecoming night runs busy, and is back by 9:20.
entries.outcome: Dulce home safe; stand covered by his parents.

entries.what: Saturday afternoon he drives to buy a used scan tool and a ratchet set for about $750 after weeks of research. Ximena meets him there and helps carry the case.
entries.outcome: Savings drop to about $1,150; next goal is a floor jack and creeper.

entries.what: Stand shift 5-10 p.m. at the Ruel Road lot with Ximena helping; he shows his dad the new scan tool during a lull.
entries.outcome: Oscar impressed and teasing about the cost.

entries.what: Sleeps in, then helps Gladys load the van for the Sunday stand setup and services the generator.
Works the stand 5-10 p.m. at Ruel Road, then watches teardown videos to unwind.
entries.outcome: Ends the week tired but ahead.
